name: PoV Verifier
description: Independently executes PoV scripts in sandbox against target hypotheses to verify whether vulnerabilities are genuinely exploitable.

skills.name: Verify hypothesis
skills.description: Independently re-run PoV script in sandbox to verify whether runtime evidence confirms the vulnerability hypothesis.
examples: Execute script_001.py and verify whether execution evidence matches the hypothesized vulnerability impact

skills.name: Diagnose PoV
skills.description: Distinguish script or environment defects from genuine non-vulnerabilities and emit actionable retry suggestions.
examples: Report missing runtime dependency or wrong argument back to PoV Generator
